runners.name: Beauty Truth Good
runners.comment: BEAUTY TRUTH GOOD was away alertly and went straight to the front, dropped from the three path to the two path early on the turn, dictated terms while remaining in the two path through that bend, responded well when set down inside the quarter-pole, came under a left-handed crop outside the furlong marker, drew off under the crop until just before the sixteenth-pole then was placed under a strong hand-ride to the finish while much the best.

runners.name: Tia Melanie
runners.comment: TIA MELANIE was rated just off the pace, dropped from the two path to the inside early on the turn, was given her cue near the five-sixteenths pole, chased the winner in the stretch and was second best.

runners.name: Girls Wear Pearls
runners.comment: GIRLS WEAR PEARLS tracked the pace on the outside, moved from the four path to the three path early on the turn, was coaxed along passing the three-eighths pole then asked for more, chased under a drive into the final furlong and weakened but was clear for the show.

runners.name: Bandmaster
runners.comment: BANDMASTER settled towards the rear, was asked while going from the inside to the three path on the turn, turned into upper stretch under a drive and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: Davidson
runners.comment: DAVIDSON settled at the rear, was roused in the three then four path on the turn, spun into the stretch under a drive and failed to rally.

runners.name: About Face
runners.comment: ABOUT FACE coaxed from the gate, chased just off the inside and then along the inside from just off the pace, spun from the two path into upper stretch set down for the drive, found a seam three-sixteenths from home and rallied on through loosely splitting foes to take command soon after just outside the eighth pole, then edged clear to the finish to prevail.

runners.name: He's My Kind
runners.comment: HE'S MY KIND four then three wide in pursuit, got let out spinning three wide into upper stretch, rallied to take narrow and brief command inside the three-sixteenths marker, got headed near the eighth pole, ran on to secure the place honors.

runners.name: Daythemusiclived
runners.comment: DAYTHEMUSICLIVED chased four then three wide coming under a ride near the quarter pole, swung four wide into upper stretch, dug in under a drive running on to procure the show honors.

runners.name: Royal Enclosure
runners.comment: ROYAL ENCLOSURE chased along the inside coming under encouragement taking the inside route into upper stretch, tipped to the two path three-sixteenths out, brushed with DR. BROWER just outside the eighth pole when following ABOUT FACE through the same lane, then kept on to the wire.

runners.name: I'm a Gunner
runners.comment: I'M A GUNNER chased three then two wide coming under urging near the quarter pole, swung three to four wide into upper stretch and improved position to the end.

runners.name: Dr. Brower
runners.comment: DR. BROWER coaxed from the gate, cut the pace just off the inside and then along the inside under pressure from FORT GRIFFIN to the outside, took the inside route into upper stretch and yielded the front straightened away, then weakened through to the finish.

runners.name: Fort Griffin
runners.comment: FORT GRIFFIN broke out a step at the start and was corrected, pressed the pace of the aforementioned foe from the outside three then two wide, spun two to three wide for home and seized command straightened away, got caught just inside the three-sixteenths pole by HE'S MY KIND, then weakened through to the wire.

runners.name: Lady Wisdom
runners.comment: LADY WISDOM tracked the pace on the outside, was asked outside the half-mile pole, chased in the three path on the turn, was driven into upper stretch in the five path, pursued the runner-up into the final furlong, gained into the final sixteenth and got up in the final two strides to narrowly prevail.

runners.name: Aqua Blaze
runners.comment: AQUA BLAZE went to the front then showed the way with a clear advantage, raced inside to the two path on the turn, was asked near the quarter-pole, came under a left-handed crop in the two path outside the furlong marker, shortened stride into the final sixteenth, led until the final two strides but was caught while able to get the place.

runners.name: Full Pour
runners.comment: FULL POUR hit the inside of the gate and had the left foot of the rider pop out of the iron, regained complete footing after going about a sixteenth of a mile, settled at the rear, was urged along while inside to the two path on the turn, moved out under a drive in the stretch and improved with late energy to get the show.

runners.name: Grace Reformed
runners.comment: GRACE REFORMED was urged along off the pace, traveled around the turn in the two path and kept on to clearly secure the last spot in the superfecta.

runners.name: Coach of the Year
runners.comment: COACH OF THE YEAR settled near the back, was asked late on the backstretch, moved from the two path to the four path on the turn, came into upper stretch in the six path and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Mathea
runners.comment: MATHEA settled off the pace, dropped from the four path to the three path under urging on the turn, drifted out in upper stretch and failed to respond.

runners.name: Startowne Road
runners.comment: STARTOWNE ROAD was well placed towards the front, chased inside on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Carmen Amalia
runners.comment: CARMEN AMALIA chased just off the inside briefly before tucking to the inside five furlongs from home, tipped back to the two path at the half mile pole and advanced to vie between rivals through the turn coming under coaxing near the quarter pole, spun just off the inside into upper stretch and seized narrow command straightened away, dug in dueling through to the finish with the runner up and gamely fended off that rival to score on the wire.

runners.name: Great Happenings
runners.comment: GREAT HAPPENINGS dueled from the two path with APERITIF to her outside down the backstretch with a few lanes between them, got joined into the turn by the top one and vied inside a pair of rivals through the bend coming under coaxing near the quarter pole, took the inside route into upper stretch and was headed for the front straightened away, dug in dueling through the stretch to the finish getting on near even terms near the sixteenth pole before ultimately being turned back and denied at the finish.

runners.name: Sacred Goddess
runners.comment: SACRED GODDESS bobbled at the break, chased three then two wide under urging from three furlongs out, spun just off the inside into upper stretch and offered up a mild kick.

runners.name: Tuthilltown
runners.comment: TUTHILLTOWN coaxed from the gate, chased four then three wide under a ride with five-sixteenths to go, angled five to six wide into upper stretch, kept on to the finish.

runners.name: Kaaterskill
runners.comment: KAATERSKILL got brushed at the break by APERITIF, chased five paths off the inside down the backstretch, tucked four then three wide through the turn and briefly was in the two path near the three-eighths marker, angled back out to swing six wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: No Need to Panic
runners.comment: NO NEED TO PANIC chased just off the inside under a ride from three furlongs out, angled six to seven wide into upper stretch, made no impact.

runners.name: Aperitif
runners.comment: APERITIF got away to an awkward start stumbling inwards and brushing the gate and then KAATERSKILL, dueled five then four paths off the inside with GREAT HAPPENINGS to her inside with two paths between them, tucked three wide into the turn and was joined inside by the eventual winner and now vied outside a pair of rivals through the turn coming under urging near the quarter pole, tipped four wide into upper stretch, dug in prominent to the eighth pole, then weakened through to the finish. Following a saddle adjustment behind the gate, GARDEN OF GRACE chased just off the inside and then along the inside under urging from three furlongs out, took the inside route into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Mysterio
runners.comment: MYSTERIO prompted the pace on the outside, was given his cue in the three path on the turn, took the lead inside the quarter-pole, shook clear under two pops of a right-handed crop in the vicinity of the furlong marker and proved best under a strong hand-ride from that point to the finish.

runners.name: Castle Pines
runners.comment: CASTLE PINES went to the front then showed the way, vied inside on the turn, was asked outside the five-sixteenths pole, lost the advantage to the winner outside the three-sixteenths pole and was outfinished while well clear for the place.

runners.name: Hundreds
runners.comment: HUNDREDS was rated just off the pace, raced between horses leaving the backstretch, was asked in the two path on the turn, chased into upper stretch and weakened while able to get the show.

runners.name: River of Deceit
runners.comment: RIVER OF DECEIT settled on the outside, stalked in the four path on the turn, made a bid near the five-sixteenths pole, spun into upper stretch in the five path, dropped back into the final furlong and tired then missed the show.

runners.name: Lake Martin
runners.comment: LAKE MARTIN dropped back near the five-eighths pole, was urged along in the two then three path on the turn, came into the stretch in the four path and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Tutto a Posto
runners.comment: TUTTO A POSTO angled in while settling at the rear, saved ground on the turn, turned into upper stretch in the three path and was no factor.

runners.name: Captain Cody
runners.comment: CAPTAIN CODY moved up under tight restraint, was rated just off the pace while tugging keenly on the bit, saved ground while let out on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Quick to Accuse
runners.comment: QUICK TO ACCUSE established the front after the start and showed the way narrowly six to seven paths off the inside down the backstretch, tucked to be in the two path through the turn and shook away midway on the bend, came under coaxing near the quarter pole and spun three wide into upper stretch, edged clear to the eighth pole, dug in and held well and safe to the finish to prevail.

runners.name: Three B's
runners.comment: THREE B'S tossed his head as the latch was sprung and brushed the near side stall at the start, chased two to three wide coming under a ride three furlongs out, swung four wide into upper stretch and offered up a mild kick.

runners.name: Moe Eighty Eight
runners.comment: MOE EIGHTY EIGHT stumbled at the start and was bumped by ONEBIGBEAUTIFULBILL, who broke inwards, chased four then three wide under a ride from the five-sixteenths pole, angled six wide into upper stretch and kicked on belatedly to the finish.

runners.name: Concorde Spirit
runners.comment: CONCORDE SPIRIT chased just off the inside and then along the inside under encouragement from three furlongs out, spun just off the inside into upper stretch, offered up a mild bid.

runners.name: Sunday Boy
runners.comment: SUNDAY BOY forwardly placed four paths off the rail down the backstretch, tucked to the two path through the turn and came under coaxing three furlongs from home, angled five wide into upper stretch, kept on under a drive to the wire but was outfinished in the late stages.

runners.name: Whittington Park
runners.comment: WHITTINGTON PARK chased just off the inside under a ride with seven-sixteenths to go, angled eight to nine wide at the top of the stretch, made some ground but no headway.

runners.name: Onebigbeautfulbill
runners.comment: ONEBIGBEAUTFULBILL broke in at the start bumping MOE EIGHTY EIGHT as that rival stumbled, chased three to four wide under a ride from the seven-sixteenths marker, angled five to six wide for home and tired.

runners.name: Caddiemaster
runners.comment: CADDIEMASTER forwardly placed seven paths off the inside down the backstretch, tucked three wide through the turn and came under motivation with three-eighths to go, angled five wide at the head of the lane and faltered in the drive.

runners.name: Lendalfoot
runners.comment: LENDALFOOT broke out at the start, was reserved off the pace, went around the turn in the two then three path, rallied in the five path into the stretch, closed strongly to get the lead inside the furlong marker then edged clear under strong urging to prevail.

runners.name: Spinning Class
runners.comment: SPINNING CLASS was rated on the outside without cover, came under some urging in the four path on the turn, rallied to the lead in upper stretch, lost the advantage to the winner inside the furlong marker and was outfinished while clear for the place.

runners.name: La Ceiba (FR)
runners.comment: LA CEIBA (FR) was well placed while rated towards the front, saved ground on the turn, moved to the two path outside the quarter-pole, made a bid in upper stretch, battled with the top two under a drive into the final furlong and weakened but just held the show.

runners.name: Mis Brunellas
runners.comment: MIS BRUNELLAS broke a half-step slow, angled in towards the rear, went around the turn in the four path, came into the stretch in the six path and improved for the last spot in the superfecta.

runners.name: Greyjoy
runners.comment: GREYJOY broke through the front of the gate prior to the start, was brought back around and deemed fit to run by the state veterinarian then reloaded, raced off the pace under reserve, was asked in the three path on the turn, made a bid in upper stretch, dropped back into the final furlong and tired.

runners.name: Putonahappyface
runners.comment: PUTONAHAPPYFACE was rated just off the pace, raced inside to the two path on the turn, moved out while asked for her best in upper stretch and lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Oscar Bound
runners.comment: OSCAR BOUND moved in while going to the front then showed the way, raced inside on the turn, lost the lead in upper stretch and gave way.

runners.name: River Tay (IRE)
runners.comment: RIVER TAY (IRE) was reserved towards the rear, shifted from the two path to the four path on the turn, swung out to the seven path into the stretch and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Ilenas Kaz Way
runners.comment: ILENAS KAZ WAY was reserved in the middle of the field, traveled around the turn in the two path and failed to respond.

runners.name: Alma's Law
runners.comment: ALMA'S LAW settled near the middle of the pack, raced in the three path on the turn, moved out around the furlong marker and came up empty.

runners.name: Exclusive Champion
runners.comment: EXCLUSIVE CHAMPION saved ground on the turn and also came up empty.

runners.name: Celestial Body
runners.comment: CELESTIAL BODY broke a half-step slow then dropped back, was reserved while tugging on the bit, went around the turn in the three path and also failed to respond.

runners.name: Pelican Pride
runners.comment: PELICAN PRIDE broke out a step at the start and brushed MIAMI STYLE, raced a bit headstrong three wide into the first turn before settling two to three wide in closest aim of the leader, remained patiently handled until placed to urging nearing the quarter pole and swung three to four wide into upper stretch, seized command with three-sixteenths to go, dug in under threat and came out three paths to look the main danger in the eye and herded that rival one path just outside the sixteenth marker, then dug in gamely to rebuff the challenge to the wire.

runners.name: Felixyn
runners.comment: FELIXYN raced three then two wide through the first turn, chased four paths off the inside down the backstretch, then tucked to the two path through the far turn and came under coaxing near the quarter pole, swung four wide into upper stretch, dug in under a drive issuing a challenge inside the final furlong, got herded out one path by the aforementioned foe just outside the sixteenths pole, dug in latched on through to the finish and was ultimately unable to get by and repelled to the wire.

runners.name: Vino Samara
runners.comment: VINO SAMARA established the front shortly after the start and showed the way crossing to the two path and then to the inside into the fist turn, settled in hand along the inside down the backstretch before heading just off the inside through the far turn, came under urging near the quarter pole and took the inside route into upper stretch under threat to the outside, yielded the front with three-sixteenths to go, dug in under a drive running on to the finish to preserve the show honors on the line.

runners.name: Bryant and Cooper
runners.comment: BRYANT AND COOPER broke in a step at the start trading a bump with MIAMI STYLE, chased just off the inside through the first turn and then four paths off the rail thereafter coming under encouragement with five-sixteenths to go, swung six wide into upper stretch, kicked on belatedly to the finish.

runners.name: Stella Fortuna
runners.comment: STELLA FORTUNA chased along the inside coming under encouragement with five-sixteenths remaining, took the inside route into upper stretch, stayed on one paced through to the end.

runners.name: Mobile
runners.comment: MOBILE stumbled badly at the start, raced just off the inside through the first turn and then two to three paths off the inside down the backstretch, went just off the inside through the far turn and was set down angled four wide into upper stretch, made no headway.

runners.name: Mobelladream
runners.comment: MOBELLADREAM raced three wide through the first turn, chased four then three wide under a ride from the five-sixteenths marker, spun three wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: She Takes Cash
runners.comment: SHE TAKES CASH just off the inside through the first turn, chased four then two wide under a ride with five-sixteenths to go, swung five wide into upper stretch, offered up a bid a furlong out, then flattened out through to the finish.

runners.name: Queen Sally
runners.comment: QUEEN SALLY chased just off the inside and then along the inside under urging from three furlongs out, angled four wide into upper stretch and made no impact.

runners.name: A. P. Slingshot
runners.comment: A. P. SLINGSHOT got bumped at the start by NIGHT JASMINE breaking outwards, came inwards after the start and forced that foe to steady, raced along the inside through the first turn before chasing three then two wide between foes, angled five wide into upper stretch and came up empty.

runners.name: Night Jasmine
runners.comment: NIGHT JASMINE broke out at the start bumping A. P. SLINGSHOT, then had that foe come inwards and was steadied at the break, chased along the inside coming under urging near the five-sixteenths, continued in the inside route into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Miami Style
runners.comment: MIAMI STYLE broke out at at the start trading a bump with BRYANT AND COOPER, then got brushed by PELICAN PRIDE, chased along the inside through the first turn and then three to four wide thereafter, angled eight wide into upper stretch and trailed. There was a pair of Objections lodged by the rider and trainer of FELIXYN against PELICAN PRIDE alleging interference in the stretch. After review, the objections were dismissed and the result stood prior to the race being declared official.
